prior_work: PR129 primary lost21.97% later. Earlier V40/V41 and BTC Flow already rejected threshold-based taker pressure. Do not present taker data itself as novel. New experiment asks whether a learned relationship adds information beyond matched price/volume predictors.
hypothesis: Aggressor imbalance and price response may interact: aggressive selling with a resilient close differs from the same imbalance during a falling close. Learn continuous coefficients from matured past outcomes rather than assign direction with handpicked thresholds.
source: Exact prior Binance spot daily990ZIP snapshot, manifest SHA da9ca6d1e782e8ef6c816390ef3e6ea363eec53a67f58592a8505d754bf5bfe2. Add originally archived taker-buy quote/base and trade count; check bounds, timestamps, archive hashes and identical OHLC against old loader. Taker imbalance is NOT net capital inflow, liquidation identification or full order-book OFI.
universe: Same9 named surviving spot assets; all dates and composition reused. Not a point-in-time complete universe or pristine OOS. No crypto loans, derivatives, short positions or live orders.
learner: Pooled ridge regression across9assets, monthly refit on up to730past signal days; at least365valid distinct dates and1500asset/date samples. Each month's training labels must mature at least7calendar days before month start. Ridge penalty0.1*n after train-only standardization; standardized features clipped to[-5,5]. Fixed model, no hyperparameter search or later-score selection. Include asset indicators, regularized with other features.
label: Seven-day forward log return from open(t+2) to open(t+9), divided by trailing60-day daily-log-return standard deviation at signal t times sqrt7; training labels clipped to[-5,5]. Predictor only consumes known features. Label availability is open(t+9); training uses maturity<=month_start-7. Calendar2022 onward is the earliest trading evaluation.
paired_models: price: lagged1/3/7/21/63 returns, distances to20/50 moving means, range, close location, turnover/trade-count surprises, BTC regime context and asset IDs

flow: exact price model plus signed taker1/3/7/21 imbalance, trailing60day standardized imbalance, flow-price interaction, flow/range interaction, price-response residual fitted on strictly prior60days
stale_flow: exact flow feature columns delayed63days, same current price features; causal information-placebo, not randomized future leakage
matched_support: All3 model fits and prediction metrics use the same feature-valid/liquid rows. Complete201-day price support, finite flow/lagged-flow features,30-day mean quote turnover>=5mUSDT. Feature scales are fit from training rows only. Save every monthly coefficient/scaling/fit cutoff and prediction.
primary: flow7_weekly. Forecast converted back to seven-day log return, require forecast>0.006 (twice declared approximate30bps round-trip costs); rank forecast normalized by predicted-horizon volatility, top3 equal slots, empty slots cash. Risk-scale using original covariance method, target20% annual vol, gross<=60%, asset<=20%. Monthly model updates are not trades or signals themselves.
policy_variants: Daily uses same primary targets but daily execution. Bold flow/price use weekly execution with vol50%,gross100%,asset1/3; deliberately do NOT preserve old risk budget. Conviction keeps primary risk and doubles forecast hurdle to0.012. BTC-only uses primary predictions but BTC as sole allowed asset,vol20%,gross60%,asset60%,weekly. These8fixed policies are all reported, not optimized.
execution: Original annual_rotation.model.simulate bytes unchanged. One10000USDT account per experiment; dailyopen with full day delay,0.1%fee+.05%adverse slippage each side, native min10USDT/1e-8lots/0.1%prior-volume cap and terminal-residual nulls. Counterfactual7day labels are learning targets, NOT filled round-trip returns; only native ledgers define portfolio profit.
robustness: Primary and matched price control: later/full double fee+slippage, extra day signal delay,1000USDT capital. Primary later Binance-trained signals executed on existingOKX prices (not fabricate unavailable OKX taker data). Primary full nine leave-one-trading-asset-out tests, do not retrain coefficients or remove historical context; this is allocation dependence only. All outcomes retained.
predictive_tests: Compare flow versus price and stale_flow normalized MSE on2024 and2025-Aug2026, using only matured outcomes. Daily paired losses averaged across assets;30day-block bootstrap2000 repeats for mean improvement with fixed seed. Overlapping7day outcomes and reused history acknowledged; bootstrap is exploratory and not a correction for all prior research. Do not equate contemporaneous price explanation with a future trade edge.
acceptance: No winner selection. Primary qualifies for more research only with complete positive full/later return,full closeDD<=20%,worst365>=-10%,doublecost/delayed later positive, incremental flow MSE improvement positive with bootstrap95% lower>0 on both evaluation periods. Any failed condition -> not admitted.500%goal separately requires full CAGR>=500% and each full year>=500%, not one lucky year.
engineering_checks: Tamper/hash/finality/volume bounds; training-maturity embargo; prefix identical forecasts/targets; perturb future labels without changing prior forecasts; same training support across3models; no borrowed target/cash; independent simple cashflow audit; old guard matches exact PR127 later report. Run locally when available and cross-check results through CI. No blocked controller/evaluation modules touched.
boundaries: Research code only. No exchange credentials, submitted orders, production scheduling or indefinite background computation. Monthly retraining is causal in algorithmic time but repeated historic experimentation remains hindsight-contaminated. Taxes, infrastructure, custody and stablecoin risks omitted.
source_interpretation: Official field meanings and an example of contemporaneous flow/price association motivate measurement only; neither source establishes this crypto forecasting model or500%profits.
